title: Q-KERNEL-modules: modules ship by version and pin, each from its own repository
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** REPO-SHAPE-1 is built (#2444); 64 of 82 `workers/core` modules already carry their own README and tests
**Done check:** cmd:git ls-files --error-unmatch doctrine/modules.lock
**Status:** closed

Group `workers/core` into about ten repositories along the audit clusters, each split with full history (`git subtree split`), each with its own version, CI and conformance slice. The kernel loads them through `core/org/modules.js` pinned by `modules.lock` (version and hash); a release is a lock bump the lane opens, canaries on a tick and merges or reverts. The monorepo stays the source of record for a group until that group's repository is.

**Prediction:** modules_pinned >= 1 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** deleting any file or history (every move keeps full history); changing a module's behaviour; the private specification (DISCLOSE-1).

size: L

**Closing probe:** cmd:git ls-files --error-unmatch doctrine/modules.lock exits 0 on main. It exits 1 today: no module is pinned yet.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T20:32:42Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
